name: Create an autolink reference for a repository
description: Create an autolink reference for a repository Users with admin access to the repository can create an autolink. POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/autolinks
context:
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/autolinks
Users with admin access to the repository can create an autolink.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)

name: Delete an autolink reference from a repository
description: Delete an autolink reference from a repository This deletes a single autolink reference by ID that was configured for the given repository. DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/autolinks/{autolink_id}

name: Get an autolink reference of a repository
description: Get an autolink reference of a repository This returns a single autolink reference by ID that was configured for the given repository. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/autolinks/{autolink_id}

name: Get all autolinks of a repository
description: Get all autolinks of a repository Gets all autolinks that are configured for a repository. GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/autolinks
context:
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/autolinks
Gets all autolinks that are configured for a repository. Information about autolinks are only available to repository administrators.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
